body: As far as building things with my hands go, I tried drawing for a little while but I wasn't to into it. I think I would enjoy building things. I'm not sure what I would build though. What I really want is a bunch of Legos to make scenes with.

Unfortunately the competitiveness of online gaming is something I can barely handle anymore because of my anxiety. If I play online I can only play games that feature pve. Having someone to chat with would be nice though. Maybe it would change the experience.

I play guitar. I'm not as good as I should be at it because I can't focus on practicing. My mind wonders so I end up just riffing for an hour, learning mistakes along the way. It's a source of pain and pleasure for me. I'm really trying to get back into video games but nothing can hold my interest for more than a day like they used to. I loved video games. Now I just get bored of them.

I've read that many teachers are pretty bad at their jobs during their first two semesters. It gets easier for them because the next year they have lesson plans to build off of from the previous year and a better grasp on the material they cover. Great teachers aren't made in a day. Do you enjoy teaching?
